canonical_project: GNC Energy / DC Korea Dangjin Seokmun National Industrial Complex AI Data Center
notes: Chungnam, Dangjin, GNC Energy and DC Korea signed an MOU for a KRW 2 trillion AI data center in Seokmun National Industrial Complex; reported floor area 72,885 sq m on 33,673 sq m site, completion/investment through 2031, about 200 local jobs. MW capacity not disclosed in accessible source.
